name: Phee Kissthermite
original_name: フィー=キステルミット
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy First Year
Class: Battle Homunculus

A first year student at Yggdrasil Girls' Magical Academy, she enrolled into the academy to improve her magical combat skills. 

Her main weapon is a magic gun, and she can harness the power of the Philosopher's Bone to transform into a bodysuit that can be worn by anyone she wishes to protect. However, this skill has a side effect: it's highly arousing to the user! The close skin-to-skin contact causes her to be in a constant state of titillation—her breathing grows heavy, and it makes her heart race.

While she looks like a normal girl, she's a very serious student, and due to her shyness, she's often unable to resist the [url=/c64356]protagonist's[/url] forceful demands. Even when her magic power runs low, she'll continue her "training" with him in order to keep her arousal in check.
